title: VK-only Single Command with complete address and qualifier interaction
purpose: Reach the Single Command information-object parser with interacting COT, common address, IOA, and command qualifier fields, using a compact complete body that can be mutated toward boundary and state variants.
expected_behavior: The server should parse one complete Single Command object, including its three-byte IOA and one-byte command qualifier, or reject it through normal validation. Mutations can independently vary the object address, activation qualifier, COT, common address, and sequence bit while preserving the enclosing frame length.
issue_safety_notes: This preserves the issue-relevant address-parser and declared-count interaction as a bounded analogue, but does not advertise an out-of-bounds read as expected behavior and does not copy the GHSA-7V97-JMWV-W5J7 reproduction bytes.
